headline: Executive order aimed at encouraging private companies to share information about cybersecurity threats.
what_it_does: This executive order sets federal policy to promote the sharing of cybersecurity threat information among private sector organizations, and between them and the federal government. No summary was provided, so the specific steps, agencies, and programs involved cannot be described with confidence from the title alone.

who_it_affects.group: Private companies and organizations concerned with cybersecurity
who_it_affects.how: They are encouraged to share information about cyber threats with each other and with the government.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies that work on cybersecurity
who_it_affects.how: They are expected to support or take part in sharing cyber threat information with the private sector.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed February 13, 2015; executive orders generally take effect when signed unless they say otherwise.
